mission: Dependency pin (CEO decision 2026-11-17 20:21 MYT; proposal reviewed 2026-11-16): Pillow==13.0.0 in services/snkrdunk_collector, services/yuyutei_collector and services/api (the API already resolves 13.0.0 unpinned, so the API and collectors stop running different Pillow versions), and pyjwt==2.15.1 in services/api (already resolved unpinned). Parity on 50 staging display images and 1,225 pairs: 0 digest, phash or distance differences between Pillow 12.3.0 and 13.0.0. DATA lane (build supply chain). Draft: the owner marks it ready, which releases both collectors.

impacts.reason: Collector images install Pillow 13.0.0 instead of 12.3.0. Infrastructure: mission-scoped sequential re-upload of the SNKRDUNK collector and the 9 Yuyu-Tei shards.
Pins the versions the API image already installs unpinned (Pillow 13.0.0, pyjwt 2.15.1), so a later upgrade can't change them silently.

resources: api image rebuild through its GitHub watch
routes: No new route. No extra source request from this change.
impact.deployment_impact: Each collector is re-uploaded on the merge commit in its own slot, with automatic rollback to the deployment captured before upload. Must start 06:00-22:59 UTC; team rule: collector deliveries only 14:00 to 03:00 MYT. The API rebuilds because services/api changed; it already runs these versions. No schema change.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures each collector's live deployment before upload and restores it on failure (recovery_deployment_id rows are reference only, carried from the last full-fleet mission grok-freshness-deadline). Afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file (one more collector release back to 12.3.0).
recovery.trigger: A collector failing after release, an image decode error in collector logs, or artwork comparison verdicts changing class on the post-release due runs.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema change and no row written by this PR.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify, including natural collector receipts on the merge commit. Then one SNKRDUNK and one Yuyu-Tei due run on staging read back from the run log, then the version-record follow-up (docs/agent/STAGING_FLEET.json) merges before anything else is armed.
